name: EdgeOne Makers Models
description: Tencent EdgeOne Makers hosted built-in model gateway.
overview: EdgeOne Makers free edition includes 500,000 tokens per month shared across built-in @makers/ models. Its API documentation supports OpenAI-compatible requests; other vendor-prefixed models require the user’s own provider key. The quota may change when the commercial edition launches. Signup requirements and card status were not independently verified.
free_access: Third-party vendor routes require own keys
Free edition quotas subject to change
notes: Base URL https://ai-gateway.edgeone.link/v1. Activate Makers and create a Models API key; use built-in @makers/ IDs.
